findings.claim: The touch points say the engine and its system libraries are pinned in requirements.txt and the Dockerfile, but `opencv-python-headless` is added unpinned and the Dockerfile is not changed.
findings.impact: A later image rebuild can pull an opencv-python-headless release that does not work with numpy==2.2.4 or rapidocr 3.10.0. Engine creation would then fail, OCR would log a single ERROR, and every picture would stay pending, without any test catching it.
findings.evidence: addons/intelligence/requirements.txt has `opencv-python-headless` with no version, next to `rapidocr==3.10.0`. addons/intelligence/Dockerfile is unchanged: base python:3.12-slim, with no libglib2.0-0 or libgl1.

bucket_proposal.reason: No declared invariant covers pinning. This is reproducibility risk.

findings.proposed_fix: Pin opencv-python-headless to the version measured on production.

specification_compliance: The diff reaches these unlisted places: Dockerfile.test; IndexDetailsResponse.image_ocr in schemas.py and api.ts; reindex_file and _get_indexed_file_or_404 in files.py; assemble_contexts in rag/context.py; the frontend test files and the core searchCapture.test.ts.
The listed addons/intelligence/Dockerfile is not changed by the diff.
Every other changed file maps to a listed touch point, to the r1 revisions (rag/context.py, core searchCapture.ts) or to the implicit spec, INDEX and review records.
potential_unspecified_behavior: A reindex request that mixes `ocr` with valid tasks is refused as a whole with 422, not split per task.
isPicture in core searchCapture.ts matches any `image/*` mime, not just the OCR set. Only text_content rows produce content_matches, so in practice it affects only pictures with OCR rows.
IndexDetailsDialog keeps its own copy of the OCR mime set (OCR_MIME_TYPES), so it can drift from the backend's OCR_IMAGE_TYPES.
regression_risks: opencv-python-headless is unpinned, so a rebuild can break engine creation, and the tests use a fake engine and would not notice.
The real RapidOCR param keys (`Det.lang_type`, `EngineConfig.onnxruntime.intra_op_num_threads`) and compatibility with the pinned onnxruntime==1.21.0 are never exercised by tests.
Ask now embeds the query whenever a picture is among the candidates.
test_coverage: The worker, queueing, status, migration, admin and RAG tests use a FakeEngine and a SearchDB double, so the real engine is not covered.
The core searchCapture tests cover the picture excerpt and the absence of a page locator.
Frontend tests cover the dialog row gating, the widget bar and card, and the admin select.
